**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 10:53
- [FACT] User has been reading a lot lately and is always up for something new.
- [EVENT] User recently helped out at the Literary Festival in their city.
- [RELATIONSHIP] User met some amazing authors at the Literary Festival, including Colson Whitehead.
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in reading more books that explore diversity in literature.
- [EVENT] User attended a panel discussion on diversity in literature at the Literary Festival.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledged the user's experience at the Literary Festival and expressed enthusiasm for their interest in exploring new books.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended several books across different categories, including:
  - Historical Fiction: "The Underground Railroad" by Colson Whitehead, "The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao" by Junot Díaz, "The Song of Achilles" by Madeline Miller.
  - Contemporary Fiction: "The Hate U Give" by Angie Thomas, "The Power" by Naomi Alderman, "The Immortalists" by Chloe Benjamin.
  - Literary Fiction: "The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo" by Taylor Jenkins Reid, "The Particular Sadness of Lemon Cake" by Aimee Bender, "The Interestings" by Meg Wolitzer.
  - Diverse Voices: "The Poppy War" by R.F. Kuang, "The Mothers" by Brit Bennett, "The Leavers" by Lisa Ko.
  - Non-Fiction: "The Warmth of Other Suns" by Isabel Wilkerson, "Just Mercy" by Bryan Stevenson, "Bad Blood" by John Carreyrou.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encouraged the user to read books that celebrate diversity and provided additional recommendations, including:
  - Own Voices: "The Poet X" by Elizabeth Acevedo, "The Sun is Also a Star" by Nicola Yoon, "The Love & Lies of Rukhsana Ali" by Sabina Khan.
  - Immigrant Experiences: "The Namesake" by Jhumpa Lahiri, "The Joy Luck Club" by Amy Tan, "The Briefcase" by Hiromi Kawakami.
  - Indigenous Voices: "The Break" by Katherena Vermette, "The Round House" by Louise Erdrich, "The Marrow Thieves" by Cherie Dimaline.
  - Disability Representation: "El Deafo" by Cece Bell, "A Curse So Dark and Lonely" by Brigid Kemmerer, "The Silent Companions" by Laura Purcell.
  - LGBTQ+ Voices: "The Miseducation of Cameron Post" by Emily M. Danforth, "The Gentleman's Guide to Vice and Virtue" by Mackenzi Lee
